# Pull Request

## Description

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Prompt Optimization / LLM Logic Tuning

## Core Changes & Architectural Impact

- **State Modifications:** (e.g., updates to `AgentState`)
- **Node logic adjustments:** (e.g., prompt revisions in `draft_spec` / `review_spec`)

## How Has This Been Tested?

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated (`pytest`)
- [ ] E2E Graph execution tracing validated successfully

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines (Ruff formatted)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of the code and prompt impacts
- [ ] No actual API keys or credentials are committed
